retrieved_evidence.text_excerpt: The experience that I want to set up for and I hoep to execute on or generally put in front of the players is to start rapidly upping the pressure. Working to drive them forward at a reckless rate. retrieved_evidence.path: corpus/eldyrwild-markdown/Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/Session 21 - Drake Nest Mirathorn Call.md
retrieved_evidence.text_excerpt: They continue on north with Karsemine and Caelynn keeping an eye out for high ground for a place to stop for the night. While on this short trip everyone is able to relax and have a short rest. Because of their timing leaving the town and their navigation skills, the wagon is able to make it far enough north to just hit the very edge of the storm and only get soaked. They are able to see the sheen of magic as the rain pools up and instead of the usual petrichor the rain smells savory. Karsemine and Caelynn spot a good camping spot on the top of a conical hill. They leave the wagon and the animals at the bottom and make their way up until they reach a giant bowl of water surrounded by a grove

As the group spends the next few minutes deciding what to do next, the majority want to leave right away, suddenly a large group of the reptiles fly up and away. Karsemine is able to tell now that they are young drakes. Based on their size five of these would be a tough battle for the group, so it doesn't look good if they are caught fighting the whole nest. Bonogo decides now is a good time to check again on how many remained in the nest. What he finds is nine young drakes remain, but he also discovers two large elder drakes and seven more sitting on smaller nests. Because of the spell from Karsemine he is able to sneak even closer without being seen. He is able to find a few valuable thing

The group continues on when they see a cloud of dust as something is moving fast in their direction. They soon encounter a young rider on a horse at top speed. She slows long enough to say that they cannot stop unless they have food for her horse so that she can continue on. The horse has clearly been running at full speed for a long time and could use a short break. Caeylynn conjures some Good Berries for the horse and fetches some water. Stafl immediately recognizes the soldier’s uniform of the Elderwild Reach, the same uniform he wore before leaving and joining this group. The woman introduces herself as Private Hester and she is carrying a sealed tube in her hand with reports for Miratho

- Storm fronts made the first march day tense; we need to plan the next weather roll beat for Session 23. - Hester Mull appeared as a courier encounter; unresolved whether the party trusts the detour offer.
- Captain Lysandra Ironveil still owes a reply on the Silver Raven dispatch thread. - The table should decide who carries the next outbound message before the march day ends.
